envoy-go-race is red: TestRoleHolderStateIsNamedByEachRoutesAnswer/publish. The first publish keeps a copy, and keepForNextHolder starts a background handover. The test then claims the role and deletes the holder's session, and the handover's resolveRoleHolder releases the lapsed claim before the second publish, which reads unclaimed rather than holder_lapsed. The test must wait for the keep's handover to end (or start the second case on a fresh role) before it claims. Grep the other rigs that keep and then claim on the same role for the same race.

A failed first lane-head read ends a claim's handover at Debug level and returns nil. In round 4 that same read failure was retried with backoff and logged at Error. Now only the 5-minute sweep recovers it, and nothing is logged above Debug. Only a failed first holder resolution is the keep's no-holder case. Retry a failed lane read with backoff from the first pass, or at least log it at Warn.

The lane head is read up to three times per handover: once by the sweep, once at the top of each pass, and again in walkKeptRole. The sweep also does both stream reads before its claim check, for every unclaimed-role lane, every 5 minutes, on every listener, for 72 h. role_keep.go is now 1001 lines. Pass the pass's head into the walk, check the claim before the sweep reads anything, and fold the single-caller helpers writeRoleKeepCursor and readRoleKeepCursor into their methods.
